Hotels.Name: Plaza Regency Hotel
Hotels.Description:
Plaza Regency Hotel is a traditional, well designed hotel located close to the Portomaso shopping area and the centre of Sliema is just 1km away.

Overlooking Balluta Bay and the Mediterranean, you’re sure to enjoy the view from the rooftop swimming pool and sun terrace. It’s connected to the main Plaza Hotel, so you’ll be able enjoy the amenities of two hotels.

Featuring a number of bars and a buffet restaurant, you can enjoy food and drink at any time of the day. As night time rolls around, head up to the roof to enjoy evening entertainment and a BBQ once a week.

The bright rooms come with climate control and facilities including a safe, ironing set and bathroom with hairdryer.

Hotels.Name: Cavalieri Art Hotel
Hotels.Description:
Set on the sea edge, the Cavalieri Art Hotel is an ideal spot for a relaxing holiday. This seafront hotel offers a variety of facilities including a curvy pool, a fitness studio, and a spa – all with panoramic views of the Mediterranean sea as their backdrop. Plus, it’s a 15-minute stroll from sandy St George’s Bay, where you’ll also find a bunch of great bars and restaurants.

During your stay you can soak up the sun on the sea-view sun terrace, take the steps down from the poolside to the sea, or go for a dip in the pool. There’s a separate swimming spot for splash-making little ones, too. If you’re looking to feel both relaxed and rejuvenated, a visit to the hotel spa is just the thing. You can book in for a variety of massage, facial, and beauty treatments.

Start your day right at the international buffet restaurant, Ottocento, which serves a fantastic breakfast spread. Between June and September, you can also enjoy à la carte Mediterranean meals at Pommarola. The hotel’s lounge bar, Baco Noir, is a great place to visit –  and not just for drinks! Along with a menu of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, the lounge bar also offers up à la carte light lunches, hot drinks, and mouth watering cakes.
